name: mineru-pdf-router
description: Convert local PDFs or remote document URLs through MinerU, automatically using the v4 precision API when MINERU_API_KEY is configured and falling back to the v1 lightweight Agent API otherwise.

interface.shortDescription: Parse PDFs to Markdown with automatic MinerU v4/v1 routing
interface.longDescription: Route local PDFs or supported document URLs through MinerU, automatically using the v4 precision API with a configured API key and otherwise falling back to the v1 lightweight Agent API. For v4, download the result zip archive and read full.md; for v1, fetch the Markdown CDN result directly. Use this when content understanding matters more than visual layout fidelity.
defaultPrompt: Convert this local PDF with MinerU, then summarize the Markdown.
Read this PDF URL through MinerU, automatically using v4 if my API key is configured.
Use MinerU first, then tell me the key risks and recommendations in this document.
